terms.metaDescription: Terms of Service, creator responsibilities and acceptable use policy for Orochia.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Effective October 6, 2026 · Orochia, open-source creator platform

paragraphs.p1: Orochia is a creator platform that may host adult content. By using it or publishing on it, you certify under penalty of perjury that:

items.age: You are at least eighteen (18) years old, or the age of majority where you live.
items.capacity: You have the legal right and capacity to accept these terms.
items.local: Viewing adult or mature media is not prohibited where you live.

paragraphs.p1: Creators keep full ownership of their media. When they publish, they agree to the following obligations:

consent.text: every performer depicted gave affirmative, voluntary, written consent before recording.

records.text: creators keep the records proving the age of every performer at the time of recording.

ncii.text: any upload showing non-consensual imagery, unlicensed deepfakes or a suspected minor leads to immediate permanent termination and a report to the authorities (NCMEC).

paragraphs.p1: Tips and unlocks are recorded in an append-only double-entry ledger. A payment confirmed by the payment provider (card, Orochia credits or cryptocurrency) is final once access to the media has been granted.
Orochia follows the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512). Copyright holders can send a takedown notice as described in our {dmca}.

dmca.metaDescription: How to send a copyright notice under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512), and who receives it.
dmca.title: DMCA copyright and takedown policy
dmca.subtitle: How to report copyright infringement under 17 U.S.C. § 512(c).

paragraphs.p1: Orochia respects the intellectual property of creators and copyright holders. Under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (“DMCA”), Orochia acts promptly on valid notices of infringement sent to its designated copyright agent.
A notice from a copyright owner or an authorised representative must include:

items.signature: A physical or electronic signature of a person authorised to act for the owner.
items.work: The copyrighted work claimed to be infringed.
items.material: The material to remove, with its Orochia addresses or video ids.
items.contact: Contact details: legal name, postal address, telephone number and e-mail address.
items.goodFaith: A statement of good-faith belief that the use is not authorised by the owner, its agent or the law.
items.accuracy: A statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information in the notice is accurate.

agent.title: 3. Designated agent
agent.note: You can also flag infringing media directly on a video page with the “Report” button, for faster review.

records.metaDescription: Compliance statement on record-keeping under 18 U.S.C. § 2257.
records.title: 18 U.S.C. § 2257 record-keeping statement
records.subtitle: Statement under Title 18, United States Code, Section 2257 and 28 C.F.R. Part 75.

paragraphs.p1: Every model, actor, creator and other person appearing in any visual depiction of actual or simulated sexually explicit conduct on Orochia was at least eighteen (18) years old when it was created.

Orochia is an open-source technical platform and hosting provider for creator-submitted material. For that material, the original records required by 18 U.S.C. § 2257 and 28 C.F.R. Part 75 are kept by the independent creator or producer.
paragraphs.p2: Before publishing anything, every creator submits a declaration naming the custodian of records and their address, confirming age verification and accepting the ongoing record-keeping obligations.

paragraphs.p1: Some visual depictions on this website may be exempt from the requirements of 18 U.S.C. § 2257 and 28 C.F.R. Part 75 because they do not show actual sexually explicit conduct, or were created before the statute took effect.

privacy.metaDescription: No advertising trackers, short-lived playback links and payments handled by the providers: how Orochia protects your data.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated October 6, 2026

paragraphs.p1: Orochia runs no third-party advertising trackers, no cross-site behavioural tracking and no data-broker integrations. What you watch, what you open and whom you tip stay private.
Each playback receives a signed link valid for 300 seconds, issued only after your access has been checked. It cannot be shared or embedded elsewhere.

Card payments, Apple Pay and Google Pay go through the payment provider's own checkout (CCBill, Segpay — PCI-DSS Level 1): your card details never reach Orochia. Cryptocurrency tips (USDT, BTC) go through a non-custodial provider; Orochia stores no financial credentials.

auctions.subtitle: Creators put videos up for auction. Bid in credits, watch the price move as bids land, and the winner — only the winner — watches it.

steps.held: Your credits are held while you lead, returned the moment you are outbid.
steps.softClose: A last-minute bid adds 2 minutes: no sniping.
steps.win: Win and it is yours: watch it, or download it when the creator allows.

open.title: No auction open right now
open.body: Creators put exclusive videos up for auction. Follow them to hear when the next one starts.

upcoming.title: Nothing scheduled yet
upcoming.body: Scheduled auctions appear here with their countdown.

ended.title: Nothing sold yet
ended.body: Videos sold at auction appear here.

bidding.title: You have not bid yet
bidding.body: Your auctions appear here: where you lead, where you were outbid, what you won.

selling.title: No auctions yet
selling.body: Put one of your videos up for auction from your library — the gavel next to it.

final.DELIVERED: Delivered — the backers were paid back in content.
final.FAILED: Not delivered in time — every pledge went back.

delivered.watch: It is here — your pledge paid for it.
delivered.locked: Delivered to the people who backed it.

challenge.noPledges: No pledge yet — be the first.
challenge.goalReachedHint: The goal is reached: pledges still count until the creator starts or the clock runs out.

errors.BAD_TITLE: Give it a title of 4 to 120 characters.
errors.BAD_DEADLINE: Pick a deadline between one hour and the longest window allowed.
errors.BAD_AMOUNT: Check the amount: pledges start at $1, an open call's pot at $5.
errors.NOT_A_CREATOR: Only verified creators can do this.
errors.REQUESTS_OFF: This creator does not take requests right now.
errors.OFFER_TOO_LOW: Your offer is below this creator's minimum.
errors.OWN_CHALLENGE: You cannot back or take a challenge you would be paid for.
errors.NOT_OPEN: This challenge is no longer open.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS_BALANCE: Not enough credits — your balance is {balance}.
errors.GOAL_NOT_REACHED: The goal is not reached yet.
errors.NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot do this on this challenge.
errors.NOT_IN_PROGRESS: This challenge is not waiting for a delivery.
errors.BAD_DELIVERY: Pick a ready video of yours not used elsewhere, or a story posted since you committed.
errors.SIGN_IN: Sign in to see your challenges
errors.TOO_MANY: Too many actions. Wait a moment.

release.FAILED: it was not delivered in time

pledge.signIn: Sign in to back this challenge.
pledge.held: Held in credits until it is delivered — back to you if not.

compose.title: Start a challenge

kindHint.GOAL: Set a goal: you make it if fans reach it.
kindHint.REQUEST: Dare one creator with an offer.
kindHint.OPEN_CALL: Any creator can apply; you pick one.

compose.creator: Creator

titlePlaceholder.GOAL: What you will make once the goal is reached
titlePlaceholder.REQUEST: What you dare them to make
titlePlaceholder.OPEN_CALL: What you want a creator to make

compose.descriptionPlaceholder: Setting, length, what it should show — be precise.
compose.descriptionHint: Everything must follow the terms: adults only, consenting, no one who did not agree to appear.

amountHint.GOAL: All or nothing: below the goal at the deadline, every pledge goes back.
amountHint.REQUEST: Held in credits now, paid only on delivery. Others can add to it.
amountHint.OPEN_CALL: Held in credits now, paid to the creator you pick on delivery.

summary.GOAL: If fans pledge {amount} within {days} days, you make a {what} and deliver it within {delivery} days. Otherwise every pledge goes back.
summary.REQUEST: You offer {amount} to {creator} for a {what}. They have 3 days to accept; accepted, they deliver within {delivery} days. Declined or late, your credits come back.
summary.OPEN_CALL: You put {amount} in the pot for a {what}. Creators apply for {days} days; you pick one, who delivers within {delivery} days.

intro.VIDEO: Pick the video you made for it.
intro.STORY: Pick the story you posted for it.

audience.BACKERS: Only its backers will watch it.

none.VIDEO: No ready video to deliver yet — upload it first.
none.STORY: No story posted since you committed — post it first.

actions.answerHint: {amount} is on the table. Accept and you have {days} days to deliver; decline and every pledge goes back.
actions.startHint: The goal is reached. Start now — you then have {days} days to deliver.

deliverHint.VIDEO: Upload the video, then deliver it here to be paid.
deliverHint.STORY: Post the story, then deliver it here to be paid.

actions.cancelHint: Withdraw it: every pledge goes back.

challenges.metaDescription: Goals, dares and open calls: fans fund custom videos and stories, creators make them — paid only on delivery.
challenges.title: Fund it. Dare it. Make it.
challenges.subtitle: Fans put credits behind what they want to see; creators make it. Nobody pays for nothing: credits are held until delivery and come back if it does not happen.

how.GOAL: A creator sets a goal and a deadline. Reach it together and they make it — miss it and every pledge comes back.
how.REQUEST: Dare one creator with an offer anyone can add to. They have three days to accept or decline.
how.OPEN_CALL: Post a challenge for any creator. Verified creators apply, you pick one, they deliver.

open.title: No challenge open right now
open.body: Start one: set a goal, dare a creator, or post an open call.

calls.title: No open call right now
calls.body: When fans post a challenge for any creator, it shows up here.

inbox.title: Nothing to answer
inbox.body: Requests sent to you and challenges you must deliver show up here.

mine.title: You have not started a challenge
mine.body: Your goals, dares and open calls show up here.

backing.title: You back no challenge yet
backing.body: Challenges you pledge on show up here.
